description: The same build served without COOP/COEP and with the service worker unavailable (init_script removes navigator.serviceWorker): the loader falls back to the single-thread player (S06 AC21, S30 R15). The player runs 3 frames after ready at a fixed 60 fps and quits (?quit-after=3&fixed-fps=60&after-ready), so the page is still while it is captured; software WebGL needs a long capture_timeout for this scene. The centre pixel is the grey floor between the middle cylinders.
